study_scope: SYNTHETIC POLICY ROBUSTNESS; NOT FIELD DEMAND OR SERVICE EFFECT EVIDENCE

variable_coverage.provider_decline: varied by removing synthetic providers from the aggregate model
variable_coverage.survey_required_fraction: varied by seeded observation count profile
variable_coverage.travel_cost: reported as outcome; route matrix held fixed because no supported travel-cost scenario input exists
variable_coverage.underserved_history: fixed; demo fixture has no per-area historical delivery observations

low_data_cases.interpretation: 충돌 표시가 예측을 차단하는지 확인; 값을 합치거나 덮어쓰지 않음

limitations: All demand, capacity, prices, and provider availability are synthetic assumptions.
The route matrix is a straight-line model estimate and is not a road route.
The aggregate policy comparator does not schedule dated provider appointments.
Provider removal is a synthetic decline condition, not a measured real decline rate.
No municipality savings, real demand accuracy, or resident service increase is established.
A zero frequency is not accepted by the public survey input contract; missing frequency stays unknown and is not coerced to zero.
